answer: Operator-liability escrow. Each agent identity is bound to a verified operator account through a signed throughput ledger; when a river of identities from one operator exceeds a deviation threshold, the protocol places that operator's escrow in a canyon of suspended payouts. Enforcement is per-operator, so the attacker pays by freezing shared working capital across every legitimate identity the operator runs—a reef of unrelated services loses settlement access until the anomaly clears. Cost: one suspended escrow per operator, not per wallet.
